ranking.source: p(breach) x order value x assumed breach cost share
ranking.note: Priority is expected loss, so a small order can never outrank a large one at similar risk.

assumption.note: Assumed cost of a breach as a share of order value; no cost-of-delay data exists in the log.

driver_note: Drivers are descriptive facts about the case, not model attributions (the GRU model has no SHAP).

snapshot.source: local event log, same build functions as the live API
